name: Uzu shaker brushes
desc: Acoustic uzu kit brushed with shaker-shuffle triplet elongation, dub-delayed rim, call/response mask breathing, phrase-end fills.

code.full: stack(s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").gain(${gain}*.7).lpf(1900), s("[sh@2 sh]*4").gain(".4 .18 .3 .16 .36 .2 .28 .15").pan(sine.range(.35,.65).slow(20)).lpf(sine.range(2400,3400).slow(32)), s("~ rim ~ [rim ~]").gain(.38).delay(.3).delaytime(.375).delayfeedback(.3), s("~ ~ ~ [~ sd]").gain(.3).every(4, x=>x.ply(2))).fast(${rate}).lastOf(8, x=>x.fast(2)).room(${room}).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("bd ~ [~ bd] [~ bd]").gain(${gain}*.75).lpf(2000), s("[sh@2 sh]*4, [~ hh]*4").gain(saw.range(${gain}*.25, ${gain}*.6).fast(4)).pan(sine.range(.3,.7).slow(12)), s("sd(3,8,<0 2 4 6>)").gain(".44 .26 .34").lpf(2400), s("<cr ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~>").gain(.4)).fast(${rate}).lastOf(4, x=>x.ply(2)).room(${room}).orbit(1).play()
